section: A value chain with a feedback loop
purpose: Make the comparison dimensions and their evaluation questions easier to scan than prose alone.
alt: Distinct roles, connected through evidence from real operation.. Represent the world: Construct or predict environments for creation, training and tests. Examples: World Labs · NVIDIA Isaac Sim · Runway. Test: What geometry, physics and action responses are actually validated? Choose actions: Map observations and goals to robot behavior. Examples: Physical Intelligence · Skild AI. Test: Which robots, tasks and environments does the policy work on? Collect experience: Build and annotate the demonstrations and interactions needed for learning. Examples: Scale AI. Test: Does more data add useful coverage or repeat familiar situations? Organize and diagnose: Find events, investigate behavior and curate datasets across recordings. Examples: Foxglove · Roboto. Test: Can an observed failure become a reproducible test and useful data? Validate and operate: Combine policy tests, controlled hardware trials and monitored deployment. Examples: Isaac Sim · Runway · robot operators. Test: What evidence justifies release, and what stops an unsafe run?
